text:
maya: Heads-up  SEO checklist for benchmark blog + webinar landing. Target publish Wed, webinar Thurs. Need keywords, schema, internal links, redirects.

sam: Added keyword clusters in the doc: 'llm inference costs', 'gpu inference latency', 'inference batching techniques'. Short/long tail pairs per section. Link: https://docs.google.com/drive/benchmark-seo

leo: Agree on short+long tail. Example: 'llm inference costs' + 'reduce llm inference cost with caching' for an internal linkable section.

maya: Action items: finalize keywords, drop-in schema for blog & event, internal link map (from /docs and /product), redirect mapping from legacy pages. @maggie takes redirects.

maggie: I need exact old->new map. If we push to Cloudflare I'll add Worker rules; Netlify -> _redirects. Share mapping by EOD Tue. We'll use 301 permanent redirects for SEO.

jen: Webinar landing: add Event + FAQPage schema, OG/twt meta, and structured CTA so Google can surface registration. Include sameAs links.

sam: Draft Article schema snippet: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"Redwood Inference benchmark: cost & latency tradeoffs","author":"Redwood Inference","datePublished":"2026-03-26","mainEntityOfPage":{"@type":"WebPage","@id":"https://www.redwoodinference.com/blog/benchmark-inference-costs"}}```

leo: Internal links: /docs/serving -> benchmarking batching section, /pricing -> cost example, blog index banner to webinar. Use natural anchor text like "benchmark: latency vs cost". Add 3 canonical links from evergreen docs.

maya: Legacy mapping from analytics (confirm targets): `/benchmarks/2024-inference-costs -> /blog/benchmark-inference-costs`, `/blog/old-latency-test -> /blog/benchmark-inference-latency`, `/products/bench -> /product/benchmarks`. All 301s.

maggie: Confirmed. I'll stage rules and add Link: rel=canonical on new pages. Test plan: smoke 200s, check 404s, monitor traffic for anomalies. Deploy window Wed 09:30-10:30 PT.

sam: Keyword placement reminder: primary keyword in H1, first 100 words, meta description, and H2s. Keep natural density.

seo-bot: sitemap refreshed 2026-03-25T15:00Z. Reminder: submit index request after publish.

jen: I'll schedule webinar email 1 hour after publish. Flag me once live.

maya: Ok team  Sam finalizes keywords by EOD Tue, Leo final content + internal links by Tue night, Maggie readies redirects, Jen finalizes schema/OG. I'll run preflight Wed morning and post publish checklist here. :rocket:
